ghs.en: Taichi: "So, cleaning, can I help you?"
Miki gives a broad smile.
Miki: "I decline."

rows.jp: 「うわーーーーーーーーーーんっ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "BWAAAAAAAAAAAH!"
Rejected!

rows.jp: 手ひどく、容赦なく、一片の同情さえなく。
rows.en: Brutally. Mercilessly. Without a shred of pity.

ghs.en: No technique, no pity, not one slice of sympathy.
ghs.assessment: 手ひどく means harshly or severely. 'No technique' is an unrelated sense and breaks the escalating series 'harshly, mercilessly, without a shred of sympathy.'
ghs.remedy: Use 'Harshly, mercilessly, without a shred of sympathy.'

highlights.text: No technique, no pity, not one slice of sympathy.

rows.en: “Taichi, you're bad with blood, aren't you?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Senpai, blood and those things are your weakness, right?"
Taichi: "Eh, well, I guess it is, sure..."
How does she know?

rows.en: A dark suspicion rears its head.

ghs.en: A dark suspicion presented itself.

rows.en: I hurl it back into the abyss in half a second.

ghs.en: In 0.5" it was beaten back to the hell it came from.
ghs.assessment: 奈落 is the abyss into which the suspicion is immediately struck down. 'The hell it came from' adds both a theological location and an origin not specified in the source.
ghs.remedy: Use 'In half a second, I knock it back into the abyss.'

highlights.text: In 0.5" it was beaten back to the hell it came from.

ghs.en: This is Miki dammit.
ghs.assessment: The source is simply the self-reminder 'This is Miki.' 'Dammit' adds irritation absent from that corrective beat.

rows.jp: 俺の大切な、たいせつな……お花ちゃんなのだ。

ghs.en: My most cherished, valued... Flower, yes.
Miki: "Senpai?"

rows.jp: 「そうなのだ。血は苦手なのだ」
rows.en: “That's right. I'm no good with blood.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "True, indeed. Blood's my weakness, indeed."

rows.jp: 「血ではないんですけど絵の具が散らばってしまっているですのだ」
rows.en: “It isn't blood, but paint has spilled everywhere and stuff.”

ghs.en: Miki: "It's not blood, but there's paint that got scattered all around, I would say."

rows.jp: 「だから掃除も大変なのですのだ」
rows.en: “So the cleanup is hard and stuff.”

ghs.en: Miki: "That is why cleaning's already a bother right now, I would say."

rows.jp: 「さらにこの短いスカートはかがむとパンツが見えてしまいますので、興奮した先輩に対処しながら掃除するのはとても大変ですのだ」
rows.en: “Also, this skirt is so short that my panties show when I bend over, so cleaning while dealing with you getting excited is extremely hard and stuff.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Furthermore, with this short skirt my panties are visible when I bend over, so I would have to deal with an aroused Senpai which would make it an even bigger bother, I would say."
Taichi: "Quite plausible, I would say."
ghs.assessment: ごもっとも agrees that the reason is entirely fair or reasonable. 'Quite plausible' only judges possibility and weakens the concession.

rows.jp: 実にストレートな物言い。

ghs.en: A very straightforward manner of speaking.
I like it.

rows.jp: 「それは確かに苦労ですのだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "This certainly looks like some work, I would say."
ghs.assessment: 苦労 describes hardship or difficulty, not merely an unspecified amount of work that 'looks like' something.
ghs.remedy: Use 'That certainly would be difficult, I would say.'

highlights.text: Taichi: "This certainly looks like some work, I would say."

ghs.en: Miki: "I've infected you!"
ghs.assessment: 伝染してます says the speech habit is rubbing off on him. 'I've infected you' adds an explicit agent and turns the playful observation into a claim of deliberate transmission.

rows.jp: 「それは確かに苦労だろうな、ごほん」

ghs.en: Taichi: "This certainly looks like some work, innit. Cough."
Miki: "Sah!"
Saluted.

rows.jp: 「ごはんはもぐもぐしているかね？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Are you going nom-nom on those meals?"
Miki: "Sah, most certainly I am."

rows.jp: 「では大人である俺はあえて身を引き、かげながら見守ることで弟子の成長を間接的に応援していこうではないか」
rows.en: “Then I, as the adult here, shall step aside and support my pupil's growth indirectly, watching over her from the shadows.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Therefore in a most mature manner I bow out, and from now on provide indirect support to my pupil by watching over her in great secret!"
Miki: "Sah, I am very thankful for that!"
